body:
CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Phase 1c-client: apps/client now renders the real server-authoritative fragment rotation Phase 1c broadcasts. Shared lookup renamed pc_falling_lookup_y -> pc_falling_lookup (returns whole PcFallingFragment, both y and rotation_deg, in one scan). Rotation applied by hand per-vertex around each debris piece's own local centroid in the XZ plane, matched pieces only; unmatched pieces unchanged. Test coverage extended to 11 assertions (was 8), 3 new covering rotation_deg. Verified via hand-traced numeric rotation example, raw-gcc compile checks, and a full clean bazel build/test (27 targets, 12/12 tests pass). Closes the client-rendering gap Phase 1c (S206-50) explicitly deferred. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
